counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text: DEM governing equations: particle motion and contact forces

counted_shapes.name: Callout
counted_shapes.text: Per particle: translational and rotational equations of motion; per contact pair: contact force and rolling-resistance torque.

counted_shapes.name: Callout damping
counted_shapes.text: Global damping −γv_i in ①: γ = 0.5 during stabilization and compression, 1e-5 during settling and relaxation (input-deck units) — see Problem 4.

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Fixed-shape DEM limits and the material point method (MPM)
Our fixed-shape implementation has no shape change and no yield cap: overlap is the only plasticity proxy; the softened SE modulus (1.35 vs ≈ 22 GPa) is an effective parameter, not a property [1, 2].
J2 plasticity on a background grid: shape change and void filling that a fixed-shape sphere cannot represent; active material is kept rigid (DEM skeleton), only the electrolyte flows.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
δ = overlap; piece-wise linear loading / unloading branches;
the implementation used here is the LIGGGHTS hysteretic law [2]

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Effective material inputs and their status
Bulk modulus from DFT; shear softening and yield stress from a pure-electrolyte calibration sweep.
Historical and current scaffold calculations use different electrolyte initializations and run configurations; they are not one validation series.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text: Tested alternatives (volumetric cap, real E) did not remove the need for effective parameters.

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Voxelizing the compacted microstructure into a transport mesh
Faces are joined by a harmonic mean with no interface-resistance term: an ideal-interface voxel model — an upper bound only within the same geometry, properties and boundaries.
VGCF as diameter-preserving segments, PTFE as a centre-line insulator, polymer as spheres; a registered 104-arm study keeps the σ(e⁻) order across 1–4 wt% VGCF on all tested grids (72/72).

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
Original Phase A campaign (VGCF E = 10 GPa): means of 96 primary arms,
three voxel sizes; no contact resistance

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Composition-dependent porosity in five simulated beds
Soft-sphere DEM with a linear hysteretic contact law, pressed to 300 MPa (nominal stopping pressure; see Problem 4); one bed per composition, no seed replicates.
One 7:3 bed: porosity 31.8 → 25.1 → 16.7 → 16.5 % (final state relaxed at fixed platen); 7:3 (large : small NCM) is the lowest of the five beds.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
Left: four stages of one 7:3 bed, 0 · 47 · 296 · 165 MPa (last = relaxed at fixed platen); porosity = exact union of spheres.
Right: final porosity of the five beds (one bed each; the red bar is the minimum).

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
From the contact network to Li⁺ transport
Contact-network approach [8]: bulk resistance + Holm/Maxwell constriction using Hertz contact radii; chosen σ₀ = 1.5 mS cm⁻¹ (pellet-literature range).
Transport tortuosity T = φ_SE σ₀ / σ_eff: 7.2 → 5.0 (0:10 → 7:3). Contact constriction accounts for 73–75 % of Joule dissipation in this network model.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
(a) transport tortuosity (Hertz), (b) σ(Li⁺) at σ₀ = 1.5 mS cm⁻¹; one bed per composition;
T is the literature "tortuosity factor" (not its square root); red = extreme of the five

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Problems 1 and 2: grid dependence and absolute σ(e⁻)
The electronic ratio decreases across the three tested voxel spacings (0.4, 0.3, 0.25 µm); the ionic ratio crosses 1. Grid convergence has not been established.
Voxel predictions exceed the available DC-polarization estimates; measurement conditions remain unverified. A registered re-run calibrates carbon on SBE alone (σ_VGCF* = 3.41 S cm⁻¹, an effective value); the DBE prediction (order only) is pending.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
(a) Grid dependence: same bed pair and convention; no converged conductivity ratio is reported.
(b) Voxel model vs DC polarization, log scale; conditions not yet matched.
(c) NCM–SE beds: no carbon/binder; Hertz H0; common NCM reference 4.1 mS cm⁻¹ [11]; size factor off; one bed per composition.

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Problem 3: Load sharing during compaction
NCM–NCM contacts contribute 48–60 % of vertical stress after relaxation at fixed platen position; 7:3 is the minimum.
The NCM–NCM stress-share ranking matches the experimental porosity summaries for the selected five compositions (exploratory, n = 5).

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
Left: contribution to σ_zz by contact type, 21 planes, load-weighted; relaxed at fixed platen.
Right: SE von Mises stress in one 7:3 bed, four stages (0 · 47 · 296 · 165 MPa), 0–150 MPa; wall SE excluded.

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Problem 4: what the 300 MPa plate reaction contains
The 300 MPa stop criterion reads the plate reaction during compression, which includes global viscous damping: in one 7:3 bed the drag is 57.9 % of the target force (750 N, deck units).
At fixed platen, the original run relaxes to 165 MPa. A combined follow-up protocol—plate-contact history reset, lower damping and force hold—reduces thickness from 111.05 to 105.84 µm. This remains a model-internal diagnostic; static-equilibrium and conservation checks are pending.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
(a) one 7:3 bed: stop step (damping 0.5), relaxed at fixed platen (original run), servo hold at the target force (damping 1e-5)
(b) ε_sphere = sphere-volume porosity, not the exact union; shaded = registered prediction band; hatched = checks still open

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Layered-bed mixing: unresolved mixing-index contrast
Rotating-drum DEM, cohesive soft contacts: ten runs from a layered start, eight revolutions; Lacey index M on 16×16×4 bins vs a random reference.
Low NCM–NCM cohesion versus the reference setting gives an unresolved paired contrast at 16×16×4 bins (ΔM = 0.0012, seed SE = 0.0073). Subsequent diagnostic classification; the original 1% overlap condition was not met.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
M = 1: random-reference variance; error bars = within-run SD; all ten runs reach M ≈ 0.96–1.00,
so this bin grid cannot separate the settings

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Exploratory cohesion settings produce different mixing indices
One seed, two revolutions: large-NCM self-pair model Bond number 38.4, 384, 1152, or all nonzero cohesion-energy densities ×10 and ×14.42 (vs the low-cohesion comparator).
Within each series ΔM rises with the imposed level; levels were chosen post hoc, and wall adhesion and start states also differ — no verdict.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
ΔM = M(low-cohesion comparator) − M(setting); hatched: bin grid failed the volume-coverage check;
ΔM includes start-state differences; M < 0 lies outside the Lacey range

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Surface energy and coating: SE–SE adhesion is the open term
With equal contact areas and an assumed geometric-mean adhesion rule, ΔW = 2(√γ_A − √γ_S)² ≥ 0 is an adhesive-work difference per unit area; SE–SE cluster survival also depends on relative surface energies and contact dynamics.
Exploratory all-pair CED scaling retains a larger SE–SE cluster fraction than the low-cohesion comparator; the confirmatory 18-run block remains on hold.

counted_shapes.name: Caption
counted_shapes.text:
Left: one seed, mean over the second revolution; whiskers = dump-resolution range, not a confidence interval.
Right: γ = surface energy, W = work of adhesion; the uncoated NCM / SE surface-energy ratio is not known.

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Tests for unresolved model limits
Grid sensitivity remains unresolved. Diagnostic results exist, while final hypothesis verdicts remain pending.

counted_shapes.name: Rectangle 4
counted_shapes.text:
Current findings and limitations
DEM and contact networks: composition trends from one bed per composition
DEM loading: the nominal 300 MPa plate reaction includes damping; a revised protocol is planned
MPM: plastic deformation, with compaction agreement dependent on initialization and loading protocol
Voxel transport: ideal-interface calculations with grid dependence and unresolved absolute conductivity
Mixing: unresolved diagnostic mixing-index contrast under an unmet overlap condition; exploratory cohesion results without a verdict
Final model-validation verdicts remain pending
